{{Quote|His name's Drenn Biktor. A tiny nothing of a man, but don't tell him I said that.|[[Nitra Vendallan]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Drenn Biktor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-com]] who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Thank you. I don't know what will happen to me now. But I couldn't go on serving the Empire. I had friends on Alderaan!|Drenn Biktor, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Drenn Biktor was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-commissioned officer]] who grew distraught over the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Due to the loss of his friends, Biktor wished to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nitra Vendallan]] saw to it that Drenn Biktor would be escorted to the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] so that he could be safely transported off world. Vendallan thought little of Biktor, but valued his knowledge of Imperial [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] supply routes, which could be useful for the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebels]] in interdicting their shipments.<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Before Biktor could be found and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Empire, a Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by Vendallan found and escorted him back to [[City/Legends|town]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Drenn Biktor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players who performed a series of quests for Nitra Vendallan in Anchorhead had to hunt down and escort Drenn Biktor back to town. Although the player could choose not to do Nitra Vendallan's quests, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />
